notes.no_fixed_minimums: Durations below are editorial CANDIDATES, not model instructions or scoring thresholds.
notes.final_song_evidence: AU: continuous 39.3s useful span, 'complete sustained performance take from start to apparent phrase end; usable as a full continuous performance'. NOT asserted to be a complete musical composition without further evidence.
notes.au_utility_tags: final_song=useful_elsewhere, practice clips=strong_elsewhere. Per owner: NOT an AU defect and NOT an absolute cross-Moment ranking; narrative significance is the Edit Planner's job vs CreativeIntent/Guide/Coverage.

first_song_but_not_familar.ambiguity: fluency stage inferred from AU; verify against footage during scoring

final_song.include: mandatory for full-progression; brief excerpt acceptable for teaser
final_song.candidate_duration_s: 15-25 continuous for a 60s Story (CANDIDATE, not a minimum); more only if the Story warrants; do NOT require the whole 39.3s unless intent warrants
final_song.ambiguity: whether a complete musical phrase/composition is captured is not established beyond 'sustained performance take'

qualitative_measures: narrative-payoff preservation (does the finale read as the payoff, not routine b-roll)
continuous-performance preservation (is the selected finale passage a coherent continuous stretch, not fragments)
significance-weighted allocation (time spent tracks narrative role, not even spread)
no forced arc / no forced long holds everywhere
